niche.name: Hidden Atlas: strange places on Earth, and why some countries are rich or poor
niche.audience: English-speaking viewers 18-45, mainly the US (also UK, Canada, Australia) who like maps, geography, economics and 'I never knew that' facts
niche.promise: Every Short reveals one surprising, true fact about a real place or country and explains WHY, with maps
angles: why a country is rich or poor (geography, trade routes, resources, smart policy)
places with bizarre laws or rules and the reason behind them
extreme places: coldest, hottest, most remote, most crowded
engineering that makes a place possible (canals, dams, tunnels, artificial islands)
how geography shaped history and money (straits, rivers, mountains, deserts)
avoid: party politics, elections, war propaganda, religion debates
unverifiable mystery claims, conspiracy theories, fake facts
topics where no free footage, photos or map can show it
niche.visual_sources_hint: Animated maps for every place story; Pixabay/Pexels for landscapes and cities; Wikimedia Commons for specific landmarks

sfx.note: Only real recorded SFX files in assets/sfx/whoosh*.wav are used; set whoosh true after adding one.
